text:
Maria T: Quick sync — I sketched a minimal negotiation & acceptance plan for regulated customers in the beta cohort. Need input on firm commitments (SLA/KMS/residency) + feedback cadence.

Aj S: +1. We should require a pilot agreement: trial -> pilot -> production. Pilot obligations: weekly feedback call, single technical POC, security checklist signed. KMS + VPC required for private data. :thumbsup:

Lee R: Agree on model pinning. If we change model weights mid-cohort we invalidate feedback. Propose a model-freeze window for each cohort (2 weeks) and a safe rollback plan.

Nina C: On recruitment — target customers with a clear product owner and at least one eng resource. Offer 2 hours onboarding + 3 feedback checkpoints (week1, week3, week6). Credit incentive: $X or extended trial.

Jon P: Ops note — we will add a canary route and automatic fallback to smaller model variant when latency > SLO for 3 consecutive mins. Also ensure daily usage snapshot + alerts for token burn.

Maria T: Draft acceptance criteria — want reactions. Trying to keep it measurable.

Aj S: ```Acceptance criteria (candidate):
1) Security: KMS configured & residency confirmed
2) Reliability: median serving latency within cohort SLO (<= 150ms) for 95% of requests
3) Engagement: >= 70% of scheduled feedback sessions attended
4) Quality: no more than 1 high-severity regression vs baseline eval
5) Onboarding: integration completed within 10 business days
```

Lee R: Suggest replacing "no more than 1 high-severity regression" with quantitative eval thresholds (e.g., pass@X or task-specific metric delta <= Y).

Nina C: Also need a churn/retention hook post-beta — commit to a roadmap meeting within 30 days of pilot end. That will help convert.

Maria T: Nice. Who owns the recruitment checklist and the acceptance tracking sheet? I'll volunteer to own the acceptance matrix, @Nina can own recruitment. @Jon can we add the daily snapshot to the ops dashboard?

Jon P: I can add a dashboard tile and a one-click snapshot export. ETA EOD Wed.

Nina C: I'll draft the outreach template and eligibility rubric. Will share a CSV with tagged prospects (integration maturity / compliance needs) by Monday.

Maria T: Cool. Next steps: 1) Nina drafts outreach & rubric, 2) Aj formalizes pilot agreement template, 3) Jon adds ops snapshot + canary, 4) Lee defines eval thresholds. Owners above; sync Thursday 10am. :calendar:

calendar-bot: Event created — "Beta cohort acceptance sync" Thu 10:00 (invites sent).

Maria T: Thanks all — this feels actionable. If no objections I'll lock these criteria and circulate the pilot agreement draft tomorrow.
